name: role_exclusive_operations_cannot_be_performed_by_other_roles
setup: canonical district ACTIVE, st1 filed at 824500, plan FY2027 still DRAFT
a CALCULATION_ERROR dispute on st1 already moved to UNDER_REVIEW by the hearing officer
period FY2027-Q1 CLOSED at clock 2026-11-16, so an audit is admissible

payload.note: the DMO liaison tries to move the budget
sponsored by the board member who holds the operation

payload.audit_note: the hearing officer tries to audit

payload.resolution_note: the auditor tries to decide the dispute

assert: the DmoLiaison board-action returns 403 with data.error_id == ERR_FORBIDDEN_ROLE, and AnnualWorkPlan.${wp_id}.status is still DRAFT with sponsor_user_id == null and version == 1
the BoardMember board-action returns 200 and AnnualWorkPlan.${wp_id}.status == BOARD_REVIEW with sponsor_user_id == board-member-01

the HearingOfficer audit-certification returns 403 with data.error_id == ERR_FORBIDDEN_ROLE, and AssessmentStatement.${st1_id}.filing_status is still FILED with audited_by_user_id == null and final_assessment_cents == null
the IndependentAuditor audit-certification returns 200 and AssessmentStatement.${st1_id}.filing_status == AUDITED with audited_by_user_id == auditor-01 and final_assessment_cents == 824500
the IndependentAuditor resolution returns 403 with data.error_id == ERR_FORBIDDEN_ROLE, and AssessmentDispute.${dsp1_id}.status is still UNDER_REVIEW with resolved_by_user_id == null
the HearingOfficer resolution returns 200 and AssessmentDispute.${dsp1_id}.status == RESOLVED_UPHELD with resolved_by_user_id == hearing-01 and granted_adjustment_cents == 0
the BoardMember transparency-record creation returns 403 with data.error_id == ERR_FORBIDDEN_ROLE and no TransparencyRecord row exists for the district at that point
the DistrictAdministrator transparency-record creation returns 201 and TransparencyRecord.${rec_fy27_id}.status == SCHEDULED with engaged_by_user_id == admin-01
AssessmentStatement.${st1_id}.effective_assessment_cents == 824500 throughout, since the UPHELD resolution grants nothing

name: shared_filing_authority_covers_the_operator_and_the_administrator_while_ownership_still_binds
setup: canonical district ACTIVE with the four-property roll, FY2027-Q1 open at clock 2026-08-01
statements generated for b1, b2, b3 and b4, all NOT_FILED
assert: the operator filing its own statement returns 201 and AssessmentStatement.${st1_id}.filing_status == FILED with provisional_assessment_cents == 824500 and filed_at == 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z
the administrator filing b2's statement returns 201 and AssessmentStatement.${st2_id}.filing_status == FILED with provisional_assessment_cents == 340000
AssessmentStatement.${st2_id}.lodging_business_id == ${b2_id}, unchanged by the administrator having acted
b2 filing b3's statement returns 403 with data.error_id == ERR_NOT_RESOURCE_OWNER
AssessmentStatement.${st3_id}.filing_status is still NOT_FILED with reported_room_nights == null and version == 1
AssessmentPeriod.${ap_id}.billed_total_cents == 1164500, the sum of the two accepted filings

name: an_unknown_operator_identity_is_forbidden_before_any_path_id_is_resolved
setup: canonical district ACTIVE with the four-property roll and FY2027-Q1 statements generated
assert: the unknown-identity call returns 403 with data.error_id == ERR_OPERATOR_IDENTITY_UNKNOWN
the known-identity call on the same absent path returns 404 with data.error_id == ERR_ASSESSMENT_STATEMENT_NOT_FOUND
no AssessmentStatement is created or mutated by either call, and District.${d_id}.version is unchanged

name: the_same_auditor_cannot_audit_and_then_certify_one_statement
setup: canonical district, st1 filed at 824500, no dispute on the statement
period FY2027-Q1 CLOSED at clock 2026-11-16 so the audit is admissible

payload.audit_note: certified by the auditor who ran the audit

assert: AssessmentStatement.${st1_id}.audited_by_user_id == auditor-01 after the setup audit, with filing_status == AUDITED
the auditor-01 CERTIFY returns 403 with data.error_id == ERR_SEGREGATION_OF_DUTIES
AssessmentStatement.${st1_id}.filing_status is still AUDITED after the refusal
the auditor-02 CERTIFY returns 200 and AssessmentStatement.${st1_id}.filing_status == CERTIFIED
AssessmentStatement.${st1_id}.audited_by_user_id is still auditor-01, so certification does not overwrite the audit identity
final_assessment_cents == 824500 and effective_assessment_cents == 824500 across both calls

name: the_administrator_who_engaged_the_financial_audit_cannot_complete_or_publish_it
setup: a FINANCIAL_AUDIT record scheduled_for 2026-08-20, required_by 2026-09-30, created by admin-01
assert: TransparencyRecord.${rec_fa_id}.engaged_by_user_id == admin-01 and the admin-01 NOTICED advance in setup returned 200 with status == NOTICED
the admin-01 COMPLETED advance returns 403 with data.error_id == ERR_SEGREGATION_OF_DUTIES and status is still NOTICED with completed_on == null
the admin-02 COMPLETED advance returns 200 with status == COMPLETED and completed_on == 2026-08-20T00:00:00Z
the admin-01 PUBLISHED advance returns 403 with data.error_id == ERR_SEGREGATION_OF_DUTIES and status is still COMPLETED with published_on == null and document_reference == null
the admin-02 PUBLISHED advance returns 200 with status == PUBLISHED, published_on == 2026-08-20T00:00:00Z and document_reference == FY2027-audit-opinion.pdf
District.${d_id}.transparency_standing == COMPLIANT throughout, since nothing passed required_by

name: public_viewer_cannot_read_the_assessment_roll_or_any_statement
setup: canonical district ACTIVE with the four-property roll, st1 filed at 824500
one PUBLISHED-track ANNUAL_REPORT record is not required; only reads are exercised
assert: the financial-summary read returns 200 with no headers at all and billed_total_cents == 824500
the transparency-records read returns 200 with response_type == array and an empty data array
the lodging-businesses read returns 403 with data.error_id == ERR_FORBIDDEN_ROLE and no roll data in the envelope
the period-statements read returns 403 with data.error_id == ERR_FORBIDDEN_ROLE

both refused calls do carry X-User-Role: PublicViewer with X-User-ID public-01, so priority 10 passes and priority 20 decides; the two served reads carry no headers at all and are exempt from priority 10 because PublicViewer appears in their §1.5 roles list
